brief:
Former Saudi intelligence chief Prince Turki al-Faisal said his country would move toward normalizing relations with Israel "tomorrow" if the Israeli government accepted a Palestinian state, Shehab Wire reported. Al-Faisal, a former ambassador to the United States and Britain, tied Saudi willingness to pursue diplomatic ties to Israeli recognition of Palestinian statehood.

The statement reflects a longstanding Saudi position linking normalization to progress on Palestinian issues, though direct talks between Riyadh and Tel Aviv have advanced in recent years amid regional realignments.

title: Saudi Arabia ready to normalize ties if Israel recognizes Palestinian state
